notes.title: Klaus Lee - Thunderballs is featured in Steam’s Games+ Germany Event!
notes.content:
Retro-Lovers and Moustache-Fans listen up!
Kicking off right now: the Games+ Germany Event here on Steam! 
Discover & explore many amazing indie games made in Germany. 

Among many outstanding games, you can also find our upcoming classic 2D action-platformer Klaus Lee - Tunderballs. 
And perfectly fitting to the ‘Made in Germany’ theme, Klaus Lee brings in not just the big Guns, but German ingenuity, with his experimental jetpack and his enemy-melting laser eyes! 

Play the fresh new action-packed and free demo now and don’t forget to wishlist the game to get notified about latest news and updates of Klaus Lee - Thunderballs! 
Even Chuck Norris is getting sweaty hands when he hears about Klaus Lee.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1776700/Klaus_Lee__Thunderballs/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Jetpack! Dynamite! Mustache! Klaus Lee - Thunderballs is Coming Fall 2023!
notes.content:
What's that? It's blue light. What does it do? Melting everything that dares to step in Klaus Lee's way!

We (Assemble Entertainment & NUKKLEAR) are excited to reveal our 2D action platformer, Klaus Lee - Thunderballs, coming to Nintendo Switch, Windows PC and Mac via Steam later this year. 

As Klaus Lee, you are fixin’ to out what it means to become the most impressive (and handsome) hero the world has never heard of, all in brilliant 2D platformer action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41598524/0432f78191c7e4eaa4321f101bc32eab1b0ea786.gif

Taking the role of the titular mustached spelunker Klaus Lee, you will explore virtual worlds ranging from deep underground caverns to buried civilizations —all of which are utterly dripping in rich, neon-hued, heavily intoxicated ‘80s inspired visuals and bawdy humor. German ingenuity never looked so good.

Klaus Lee wasn’t always battling enemies in a side-scrolling adventure-platformer, though. He was once a Beverly Hills cop, then a private investigator and Hollywood stuntman who also taught Chuck Norris how to walk, taught Gene Simmons how to rock, and dated all of Charlie’s Angels at the same time. You might say Klaus Lee is a man who’s truly done it all. He even taught Maverick how to fly. But even the world’s most interesting men aren’t immune to the powers of rudimentary ‘80’s technology, which is how he got sucked into his TV screen and ended up in a video game. 

Check out the newest trailer here:
[previewyoutube=XVfX-1Qlrws;full][/previewyoutube]


About Klaus Lee - Thunderballs
So, what will you do as such a mythical man? Stuck in a video game from the 80’s, you’re of course trapped in an old school platformer. But don’t you dare think it’s going to be boring just because it’s old. You get to utilize a jetpack, dynamite, and even laser eyes as you traverse your way through over 100 unique levels. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41598524/19ffd1defaa4fe8873feb537cd0a3752d7ade63f.gif

Thanks to a handy dandy level editor, take your creative skills to the next level (literally) with robust design options where anything you dream can be created, destroyed, and created again. With hundreds of options and endless possibilities, put your mightiest ideas to the test and have Klaus Lee try them out, then unleash them to the world via cross-platform level sharing ability. Then, be sure to try out other community-created levels to see if you can outsmart them. Of course you will, but we have to say that.

Features of Klaus Lee - Thunderballs
 Where’d I Put My Mustache Oil?: Join the mustachioed hero Klaus Lee through a classically crafted story of humor and fun where the 80s cliches know no bounds.  
 Prepare For Take Off: Strap on your old school, high power jetpack to travel through over 100 unique, brain-bending levels, then, power your way through levels created by fellow Klaus Lee superfans. 
 Spikes & Bats & Bugs, Oh My!: Deadly traps and vile beasts of all sizes ensure this adventure platformer is never short on action. Dodge nasty insects, temple traps, and other hazards where every level is a puzzle to be solved! 
 Games Couldn’t Do This Back In My Day: Enjoy cross-platform functionality to see what everyone, everywhere is up to and creating in the wonderful world of Klaus Lee.

Eye-candy
